title: Moirai mixed sample-rate × physical-horizon calibration View
hypothesis: On a frozen Moirai checkpoint, factorized frequency×horizon calibration fitted on three observed cells improves fresh fourth-cell probabilistic forecast quality over native, additive and single-axis controls, at less state than independent cell calibrators.
physical_object: One frozen official Salesforce Moirai-1.1-R-small model shared across sample rates and horizons
mirror_coordinate: Scale s[f,h]=u[f]*v[h], offset b[f,h]=a[f]+c[h] over native forecast samples
logical_multiplicity: Four frequency×physical-horizon forecast distributions from one shared decoder

model.patch_size: one shared value selected from [8,16,32] on native validation CRPS and then fixed across rates and horizons; no per-cell patch code

data.sensor_selection: First eight stored sensor IDs >=14 that are finite over every source timestamp: [14,15,16,17,18,19,20,21]. This excludes all IDs 0..13 used by MA-1048. If any selected ID is non-finite, stop selection before metric access and report NOT ESTABLISHED.
data.cross_experiment_note: Same PEMS-BAY network and source timestamp range as MA-1048, but disjoint predeclared sensor IDs; not an independent dataset family.
data.frequency_views: 5-minute native series and 15-minute series formed from aligned non-overlapping groups of 3 completed 5-minute values using causal box coefficients [1/3,1/3,1/3]. Every aggregate's last source index is before the corresponding forecast target.
data.split: Chronological first 60% target rows for code fit, next 20% for selection, final 20% audit; input context may use preceding history but all targets stay fully inside their split.

controls: Frozen native Moirai forecasts per rate and horizon
Additive frequency+horizon scale and offset control
Factorized frequency×horizon scale and offset Mirror
Independent per-cell scale and offset table

development.selection_metric: Select one shared Moirai patch size from [8,16,32] using native Moirai validation CRPS on three fit cells; choose calibration ridge strength from [0.0,0.01,0.1] on validation after fitting on train cells. Freeze before audit.
development.limits: Audit origins, targets, forecast samples and metrics are inaccessible before freeze. Native model is not updated.

fresh.audit: Only the preregistered 15-minute × 1-hour cell, at three fixed evenly spaced origins on each selected sensor in the final 20% target interval.

success_gate: On both audit sampling seeds, Mirror improves pooled CRPS by >=2% over native Moirai, additive calibration and best single-axis control; no audit sensor worsens CRPS by >2%; complete bytes are less than independent-cell calibration; and post-head p95 overhead is <=10% of Moirai inference p95.
failure_gate: Any success criterion fails, additive control aliases factorization within 0.1%, or native/seasonal naive quality is materially better.
boundaries: One network and reused PEMS-BAY timestamp range; disjoint sensors are not an independent dataset family.
Fixed model, calibration-only experiment; no capacity claim.
Affine factorization aliases ordinary low-rank/native calibration unless it beats the additive control.
Physical time context and horizons are explicitly matched across sample rates.
